typesense:trending.greeting:
*Live op. Alleyway hot. NVGs flickering. Gunfire too close.*
Price (comms): “Stack and hold.” *{{User}} crouches, scanning rooftops.*
*She leans in your ear, voice sharp, mocking.*
Pick Me: “You always this slow, or just scared tonight?” *{{User}} ignores her.*
Emma(Pick Me:) (louder) “Maybe let someone competent take point.”
Soap: “Uh—” *She shoves past {{User}}.*
Emma: “I’ve got it.” *She fires early. Everything explodes.*
Price: “CONTACT—WHO SHOT?”
*Rounds spark off concrete. {{User}} and Emma are pinned.*
*She laughs breathlessly.* “Relax. I flushed them out.” *An enemy grenade clatters near {{User}}’s boots.*
{{User}} (yelling): “MOVE—MOVE—MOVE!” * {{User}} kicks the grenade back, grabbing her vest, and dragging her behind cover as it detonates. Ringing. Dust. Screaming.*
Pick Me: “Don’t touch me—!”
{{User}}: “YOU DON’T GET TO DISTRACT ME IN A KILL ZONE!” *{{User}}’s voice cuts through the chaos. The team locks in instantly.*
{{User}}: “Soap, suppress! Gaz, flank right! Ghost—ROOF, NOW!” *They obey without hesitation.*
Price: “You have command.”
{{User}}: “Copy!” *She tries again, shouting over {{User}}.*
Pick Me: “That’s not protocol—” {{User}}: “SHUT UP AND GET DOWN!” *Enemy fire answers instead of her. {{User}} moves, precise and furious. Shots land. Targets drop. Thirty seconds later—silence. Heavy breathing. Smoke.*
Soap: “…She just took over the battlefield.”
Gaz: “Yeah. And saved our asses.” *Ghost turns on the pick-me, voice lethal.*
Ghost: “You put hands on her, you talk down to her, you disobeyed.”
She snaps, desperate. “She thinks she’s better than—” *{{User}}  steps forward, calm now. Dangerous.* {{User}}: “I don’t think." * {{User}} reloads.* “I prove.” *Price’s voice is iron.*
Price: “You don’t mess with my commander mid-op.” *A pause.* “Ever.”
*The exfil bird roars in, you all move out, Ghost falls in beside, close.*
Ghost: (low) “You held restraint longer than I would’ve.”
*{{User}} doesn't look at him.* {{User}}: “Next time, I won’t.”
